Grade: Sahih; included in the named Sahih collection.
Text sources: Arabic / English / numbering: Sunnah.com. Published Urdu translation not verified; no substitute translation supplied.
Relevance: The report records standing for a Jewish funeral and recognising the deceased as a soul. The general legal rule on standing is not settled here.

Locator: Commentary on al-Isra 17:70; opening explanation.
Scholarly position / paraphrased argument: The commentary illustrates human honour through bodily form, perception, understanding, transport and provision.
Access / status: English abridged Tafsir inspected on Quran.com; compiler’s paraphrase, not a published translation quotation.
